protocol.workerReuse: One worker, sequential calls throughout the completed run
protocol.timingBoundary: Public worker-handler entry through awaited completion, including validation/admission, lazy encoder/kernel initialization inside the first handler and response construction. Excludes worker construction and packed-script loading/evaluation before handler readiness, input file I/O, input hashing, request clone and result hashing/transfer. Handler wall duration and worker-thread CPU are reported.
protocol.firstCallEffects: Lazy encoder/kernel initialization within the first handler and first-call/JIT effects are retained in request ordinal 1
protocol.aggregation: Sum of observed handler durations per effort; cost ratios divide these complete matched-corpus totals by effort 7
protocol.statistics: One observation per image/effort; no repeat-based variance, repeatability or median claim
protocol.msPerMegapixel: Observed total milliseconds divided by total megapixels for this measured corpus only; not a prediction for unmeasured image sizes

validation.scope: Exact retained-stream SHA-256 and length identity reuses the established earlier two-decoder RGBA proof, including alpha and hidden RGB. This run performs no new decoding.

effort9ComparedWith8.interpretation: Ratio of the same complete matched-corpus totals; no universal effort recommendation
